sources.title: Anthropic, PBC Amendment No. 2 to Form S-1, November 10, 2026

event.title: Anthropic discloses amended Google Cloud compute commitment
event.summary: Anthropic disclosed that its Google Cloud hosting agreement, amended through October 2026, commits Anthropic to spend at least about $121.3 billion through July 2033 regardless of usage.

amounts.label: Minimum Google Cloud hosting commitment
amounts.quote: In March 2026, we entered into a CSP hosting agreement with Google, which was subsequently amended between May and October 2026, pursuant to which we committed to spend at least approximately $121.3 billion between April 2026 and July 2033, regardless of actual usage.

facts.label: True-up
facts.text: If Anthropic spends less than the commitment, it must pay Google the difference, subject to adjustments and exceptions.
facts.quote: If our actual spend falls short, we must pay Google the difference as a true-up subject to certain adjustments and exceptions if available.

facts.label: Cancellation
facts.text: The commitment is non-cancelable except for Google’s uncured material breach.
facts.quote: Our commitments under such agreement are non-cancelable except in the event of Google's uncured material breach.

relations.note: Separate TPU-based capacity collaboration involving Google and Broadcom.
